glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late evening, but today at 21:54 it was at nightstand_b1 (correct) while at 08:28 it was at desk_o1 (I guessed nightstand_b1). The "return to nightstand for sleep" rule holds for post-22:00, but in the morning (08:00-09:00), glasses are often at desk_o1 as Dana starts work. Do not default to nightstand_b1 before 09:00; check desk_o1 first.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but today at 19:44 it was at kitchen_table_k1 (I guessed desk_o1). The "desk_o1/sink_k1 during work hours" heuristic is unreliable for late afternoon/evening (post-17:00). By 19:00, Dana is likely winding down or eating, moving bottles to kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for water bottles between 17:00 and 21:00. Do not default to desk_o1 after 17:00.

General Pattern: The "coffee_table_l1 as central hub" heuristic is ONLY reliable for early morning (pre-08:00) and very late evening (post-22:00) for mugs and water bottles. During work hours (09:00-17:00), Dana’s items (mugs, water bottles) frequently move to desk_o1 (work) or sink_k1 (refill/clean). For glasses, they are at desk_o1 in the morning (08:00-09:00) and return to nightstand_b1 for sleep (post-21:00). For water bottles, they shift to kitchen_table_k1 in the late afternoon/evening (17:00-21:00). Always adjust location based on specific time-of-day transitions rather than broad "workday" or "evening" labels.
